mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, password, nickname, avatar, signature, role, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, nickname, role, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{role}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT post_id, board_id, author_id, title, content, view_count, like_count, comment_count, is_top, status, create_time, update_time FROM forum_post WHERE author_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, parent_comment_id, reply_user_id, content, like_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM forum_comment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT user_id, username, password, nickname, avatar, signature, role, status, create_time, update_time FROM sys_user ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
